scope.contract: Per-output-row device bias added after alpha*AB+beta*C and before activation. Bias stride0 broadcasts across batches; padded positive stride selects per-batch row vectors. Null pointer disables bias. Default dtype matches f32/f16/bf16 matrices; low-precision matrices may use FP32 bias.
scope.coverage: sparse A/B, both orders/transposes, strip/TILE/partial tiles, three matrix types, default/explicit FP32 bias, bias broadcast/batched stride, A/B/C zero-stride broadcasts, six activations, NaN-poisoned zero-alpha/beta paths, valid in-place C/D, pointer/type/stride descriptor mutation after plan creation, immutable bias input/guards, independent compression decoding and CPU double GEMM reference
scope.validation: exact pointer/stride/type attribute sizes and getter guards; invalid stride/type/misaligned pointer preserves old state; D/bias exact or partial span aliases rejected; borrowed device bias pointer must remain alive until GPU work completes
